reconstruction_protocol.angle_limit_policy: ignore MATPOWER angle-difference limits because they are absent from the paper model
reconstruction_protocol.generator_policy: retain every MATPOWER generator row; originally offline rows are fixed at zero output and zero reserve
reconstruction_protocol.inactive_branch_policy: retain paper-count rows as zero-flow rows while excluding them from topology
reconstruction_protocol.load_definition: MATPOWER Pd + Gs treated as active withdrawal
reconstruction_protocol.load_profile: flat MATPOWER active demand in every period
reconstruction_protocol.objective_policy: use the linear and constant MATPOWER polynomial terms; reject nonzero higher-order terms
reconstruction_protocol.ptdf_reference_policy: use the public MATPOWER type-3 reference bus
reconstruction_protocol.renewable_placement: cycle through MATPOWER generator buses in ascending generator-row order
reconstruction_protocol.storage_placement: use every second reconstructed renewable location, cycling deterministically when required
reconstruction_protocol.zero_rate_a_bound_proof: outward-rounded triangle bound over the complete variable box
reconstruction_protocol.zero_rate_a_policy: retain the paper-required branch rows with a finite bound derived to be redundant over the variable box
